Reporting into the North America Fixed Video Pelco leadership, the Distribution Channel Account Manager - Strategic Accounts is a high-impact executive role designed to spearhead the evolution of our market presence. This leader will move beyond traditional distribution management to architect the strategic frameworks that align our most significant partners with Pelco's long-term vision. You will be the primary catalyst for business transformation within our strategic accounts, leveraging Pelco's decades of innovation to secure global market leadership. We are looking for an authoritative leader who can navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, inspire cross-functional excellence, and deliver a profound impact on the trajectory of our Video Security & Access Control division.

title: Solutions Product Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products.

ROLE

We're looking for a Solutions Product Marketing Manager to define and own Baseten's up-market, enterprise, and industries go-to-market strategy. You'll build the playbook that helps Baseten win large, complex deals and the vertical go-to-market strategies that let us compete in Financial Services, and Health & Life Sciences, and the use cases that scale across all of them.

This is a highly cross-functional, largely greenfield role. You'll partner closely with the Industries sales team, product marketing, demand gen, and executive leadership to build on our enterprise go to market motion.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Deal Playbook & Buyer Enablement

- Build the enterprise deal playbook and full bill of materials (BOM) - pricing guides, one-pagers, TCO/ROI guides, landing pages, and event/field collateral - mapped to every stage of the buyer's journey

- Build the system for keeping every sales asset current - clear ownership, last-updated dates, and a refresh cadence

- Develop industry-specific event concepts featuring anchor customers and AI-native accounts to build credibility with target executive audiences

Vertical GTM & Industry Go-to-Market Kits

- Build vertical sales kits and ICP/positioning frameworks for priority industries

- Own industry-specific landing pages, messaging, and TCO guides, extrapolating from early AI-native accounts to larger enterprise targets

- Design and help launch an ABM experiments in partnership with demand gen

Industries AE Enablement & Onboarding

- Design role-specific onboarding for Industries AEs, including certifications, customer-grounded scenarios, and async, refreshable content

- Build sales playbooks tied to real customer examples, and package assets into an AE-ready enablement motion (first call, competitive deals, legal/finance/procurement, TCO/ROI, self-hosted)

- Become a trusted partner to the industries team so onboarding and enablement stay grounded in what sellers actually need

QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years in product marketing, solutions marketing, or a related GTM function, ideally at a technical or infrastructure company

- Experience building enterprise or vertical go-to-market motions - ICP definition, buyer journey mapping, and full-funnel sales collateral

- Comfort translating technical, infrastructure-heavy concepts (inference, self-hosted deployment, TCO/ROI) into narratives for both technical buyers and non-technical stakeholders like legal, finance, and procurement

- Track record designing and running sales enablement or onboarding programs for technical sellers

- Strong cross-functional coordination skills - you can pull together sales, customer marketing, demand gen, and executives around a shared plan

- Comfortable owning execution as well as strategy: landing pages, decks, one-pagers, and written content, not just frameworks

- Thrives in ambiguity - this role is about building the enterprise motion from a fairly blank slate

BONUS

- Experience in (or a fast ability to ramp on) financial services, manufacturing/industrial, or health/life sciences

- Experience running or contributing to a Customer Advisory Board or executive champion program

- Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure, inference, or developer tools

- Experience partnering with technology partners on co-marketing or joint events

title: Technical Sourcer
description:
.

About the role:

Hex is scaling quickly, and the quality of our team is the single biggest driver of that. We're looking for a Technical Sourcer who treats sourcing as a craft and a system, someone who can build repeatable pathways to finding exceptional technical talent including engineers, designers, and product builders. This isn't a role about running the same LinkedIn playbook - we’re looking for creativity in using AI tooling to unlock sourcing capacity, and find delightful ways to engage passive talent who aren’t even thinking about their next role yet. You'll own how we discover and rediscover talent, and you'll use AI to do it with far more precision, personalization, and leverage than a traditional sourcing motion allows. If you like the idea of being early to a genuinely new way of working and setting the standard the rest of the team learns from, this role is for you.

What you will do:

- Own top-of-funnel sourcing strategy for our hardest technical searches across Engineering, AI, Infra, Product, and Design, going narrow on niche roles and building stacked funnels for evergreen ones.

- Build and run an AI-forward sourcing stack: use AI sourcing tools, agents, and automation (e.g. Juicebox, LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, GitHub, etc.) to power discovery, enrichment, and outreach at the top of the funnel.

- Design and iterate on AI-assisted outreach that engineers actually respond to: highly personalized, technically credible, and human. You'll build the prompts, templates, and workflows the team reuses.

- Map deep talent pools and competitive companies to surface "undiscovered" candidates, not just the obvious ones on LinkedIn.

- Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to calibrate profiles in real time, then translate that into precise, searchable criteria.

- Track conversion and response rates, A/B test messaging, and use data to pivot when a search goes stale.

- Continuously evaluate new AI sourcing tools and share what works, helping raise the bar for how the whole Talent team sources.

About You:

- 4+ years of technical/engineering sourcing experience, ideally at a high-growth startup

- Fluent with AI tooling for recruiting: you've already used (or are eager to master) AI sourcing tools, agents, and automation, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they don't.

- You've built sourcing programs, pipelines, or AI/automation workflows from scratch rather than inheriting them.

- Technically literate: you can read a GitHub profile, skim a research paper or engineering blog, and understand what makes someone exceptional rather than just experienced.

- A precise operator: organized in your systems, calibration, market mapping and pipeline updates

- Strong "hunter" instincts and comfort with ambiguity; you have urgency about what you do and operate without a ton of instruction

- Creativity: you’re not bringing the same LinkedIn playbook to attract engineering talent, you think outside the box on how we can create unique touch points that having a lasting impression.

- You care about the candidate experience: your outreach feels human (even when AI helped write it), you move folks through quickly, you prioritize updating candidates and you know how to advocate for them early in the process.

- Experience with Ashby, and sourcing tools like Gem, Juicebox, Noon, Metaview, etc.

In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. • Own agency and vendor relationships across media buying and production.

• Measure performance across pipeline, CAC, and revenue, and use those insights to guide investment decisions.

• Partner closely with Analytics, Product Marketing, and Finance to prioritize growth opportunities.

• You've built and scaled paid acquisition programs across multiple channels.

• Experience owning strategy, budget, execution, and measurement.

• Strong understanding of paid social and familiar with CTV, OOH, radio, podcasts, and other emerging channels.

• Experience designing experiments and measuring incrementality.

• Strong analytical skills with a track record of using data to make investment decisions.

• Comfort working in ambiguity and building new programs from scratch.

• Excellent cross-functional partner who works effectively with Design, Product Marketing, Analytics, and Leadership.

Experience that stands out

• Built new acquisition channels from the ground up.

• Scaled paid social for a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

• Experience across emerging channels like CTV, podcasts, OOH, or audio.

• A track record of turning experiments into repeatable growth.

• Partnering closely with Creative, Product Marketing, and Analytics.

• Using AI to move faster, test more ideas, and improve campaign performance.

Salary range $180k - $200k.

What You’ll Own

• Define and lead the strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of interconnected products and platforms.

• Own end-to-end outcomes, including performance, adoption, and impact across systems and vendor partnerships.

• Establish and drive a metrics framework that sets the standard for product performance and accountability.

• Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions, balancing speed, cost, and long-term scalability.

• Partner with Engineering on architecture and platform decisions, ensuring alignment with business and clinical priorities.

• Design member-centric experiences, including conversational and interaction flows that guide individuals to the right care at the right time.

• Influence cross-functional strategy and investment decisions across Product, Clinical Operations, Growth, IT, and external partners.

• Shape how adjacent teams prioritize and execute work beyond your direct scope.

• Establish governance, documentation, and compliance standards to support scale in a regulated healthcare environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Improve member engagement and care navigation through thoughtful product design.

• Drive measurable gains in clinical outcomes and operational efficiency.

• Elevate product practice through data rigor, experimentation, and mentorship.

• Enable smarter, faster decisions through clear metrics and actionable insights.

Qualifications

• 7-10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of platforms, infrastructure, or shared systems at scale.

• Experience operating at a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior IC level.

• Proven ability to define and execute portfolio-level strategy across complex, interconnected systems.

• Strong track record of data-driven decision-making, including defining and operationalizing metrics.

• Experience designing conversational or AI-driven user experiences (chat, voice, messaging).

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations.

• Technical fluency to partner effectively on architecture, integration, and reliability trade-offs.

• Demonstrated ability to raise the bar for product teams through mentorship, standards, and best practices.

Preferred Experience

• Healthcare, behavioral health, or other regulated, mission-critical environments.

• Experience with automation, messaging platforms, or AI-enabled product strategies.

• History of insourcing vendor capabilities or rebuilding critical systems.

• Contributions to scaling product organizations (hiring, leveling, coaching).

title: Operations Manager

• Turn rider and community feedback into tangible improvements, spotting patterns and collaborating with internal teams to make thoughtful and actionable operational improvements.

Job Purpose
The Business Operations Coordinator is an entry-level, high-potential role built for a natural systems thinker - someone who's energized by figuring out how the pieces of a complex process connect. Using our CRM and internal data and reporting tools, the Coordinator investigates escalated customer and provider partner issues, digs past the symptom to find the root cause, and partners with toll agencies and internal teams to fix not just the individual case but the process behind it.
Deep tolling industry knowledge isn't required on day one - strong analytical instincts and a comfort with technology and data are. This role is designed to build both, developing the Coordinator into a go-to technical troubleshooter within Business Operations.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Investigates escalated customer and provider issues using CRM and internal data tools, tracing each issue to its root cause rather than treating symptoms alone.

• Approaches problems systemically - mapping how provider data, agency processes, and internal workflows connect to identify where breakdowns actually start.

• Analyzes case and usage data to spot patterns across issues, surfacing recurring problems and revenue-loss or violation risk before they grow.

• Collaborates and liaises with Operations and providers to help define technical requirements and provide domain expertise in pursuit of issue closure and continuous process improvement.

• Partners with Operations, Development, and Product to recommend fixes - a process change, a new report or dashboard, or a product enhancement - accomplished through new technology or alternative use of existing technology.

• Documents findings and recommendations clearly enough for teammates, managers, and product owners to act on.

• Engages with customers on an as-needed basis.

• Maintains broad knowledge about the company's services.
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of task activities and/or duties that are required of the employee for this job. Responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Experience and Competencies
This is an entry-level position - we're hiring for mindset and potential, not a resume.

• No prior tolling or transportation experience required (helpful, but not necessary).

• A natural systems thinker: curious about how things connect, and comfortable pulling on a thread until an issue makes sense.

• Comfortable with technology and data:willing to work in spreadsheets, CRM records, and reports to find answers; basic Excel skills expected, more is a plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts; able to break a complex issue into parts and reason through it methodically.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external customers.

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team.

The Technology Production Supervisor is the hands-on technical leader who runs that production day to day.

title: Entry Level UX Design Apprenticeship
description:
About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Account Executive (Education)
description:
About Us
Cardinal Education is a dynamic and collaborative educational consulting company dedicated to providing students and families with superior academic support and admissions expertise. Our rapidly growing enterprise offers Educational Consultants the opportunity to make a significant impact from the start while prioritizing exceptional experiences for families and providing substantial growth opportunities within the company.
Culture at Cardinal Education

Collaboration is key to our culture at Cardinal Education , where open communication and diverse perspectives are valued and drive success. We foster innovation and learning through a supportive environment that encourages growth. Our team is passionate about education and creating a dynamic and inclusive workplace.
The Opportunity
We are hiring our first dedicated Educational Sales Consultant to take ownership of our high-volume, inbound pipeline. Historically, our senior Educational Consultants have managed the sales process. As our business scales, we need an experienced sales professional to close inbound leads so our experts can focus entirely on delivering world-class client results.
This is not a cold-calling role. The phone rings consistently, and during our peak season (August-December), we generate an overwhelming amount of inbound interest, ensuring a deep, continuous pipeline of warm leads for our team. We need a closer who can build immediate trust, navigate complex family dynamics, and effectively articulate the value of our high-ticket mentoring, test prep, tutoring, and admissions services.
What You Will Do

• Manage Inbound Sales: Own the sales cycle for our primary services (Tutoring, Test Prep, and Private School and College Admissions) with ticket values typically ranging from $4,000 to $50,000+.

• CRM and Pipeline Management: Execute the current sales process while bringing your expertise to refine and elevate our systems. Utilize Salesforce to mine existing leads and maximize our exceptional lifetime customer value (LTV).

• Client Advising: Act as the initial guide for families, diagnosing their specific educational needs and recommending the appropriate level of service (from standard tutoring to elite coaching).

• Cross-Selling & Expansion: Leverage our long-term client relationships to cross-sell multiple services across a family's 7-8 year journey with Cardinal Education .

Who You Are

• An Educational Insider: You have strong experience in education sales, admissions counseling, EdTech, or any adjacent industry. You understand the nuances of the industry and don't need to be trained on the basics of high-stakes academic metrics.

• A Consultative Closer: You excel at high-ticket sales and know how to build credibility and trust quickly with an affluent, demanding clientele.

• A Team Player and a Relationship Builder: You are looking for a long-term home to build your career. You understand that in high-stakes education, long-term client success and team collaboration matter far more than just chasing the next quick close.

• Systems Oriented: You are comfortable working within CRM systems (like Salesforce) to manage a heavy flow of leads and track pipeline velocity.

Why Join Us?

• Zero Cold Calling: Step into a role with a massive, proven inbound lead pipeline.

• High LTV: You aren't just selling one product; you are building a book of business with families that return year after year for new services.

• Competitive Compensation: We offer a strong compensation package (OTE range $80k - $120k ) designed to provide stability without the constant "feast or famine" typical of a meat-grinder sales culture.

• Remote Flexibility: Live and work where you want. You do not need to be based in the Bay Area.

You will lead cross-functional coordination for rollouts, clearly document changes and their impacts, develop training and communication materials, and manage all change- related communications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading budget and forecast for various departments, providing financial insights and analysis to support decision-making, identifying & monitoring key KPIs, and developing financial models. This role will collaborate with other departments and HQ to improve financial performance and support strategic initiatives and recommend corrective action to meet financial targets.

About the Role

• Actively drive various forecasts, annual budget, and long-term plan processes

• Create timely, accurate, and standardized global reporting that is easy to replicate and maintain across brands

• Serve as the business partner and lead finance counterpart to various operational departments, providing strategic guidance on cost control, margin improvement, and financial performance optimization

• Oversee the financial performance of key business segments, offering insights to drive operational efficiency and profitability

• Review month-end results, forecast and budget assumptions, and challenge outcomes based on business performance and key performance indicators (KPIs)

• Identify, monitor, and leverage KPIs to measure financial and operational performance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to support strategic initiatives

• Continuously challenge, streamline, and simplify current processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness

About You

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field

• 2+ years of professional experience in corporate FP&A, operational finance, or related field

• Understanding of and experience with key financial concepts, financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting and variance analysis

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and trends

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information to senior leadership and operational teams

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling software

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment

Preferred Qualifications 

• Master's degree in finance, accounting, or related field

• Completion of Financial Leadership Development Program (FLDP) or Financial Leadership Rotational Program (FLRP)

• Oracle Fusion, Adaptive Insights, NetSuite ERP, and Hyperion Planning proficiency

• Knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, SEC regulations

• Experience in PE background company with international business presence

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

title: Junior Simulation Researcher
description:
Our teams are putting the world’s retailers online using robotics, AI, IoT and the cloud. We provide services to our partners globally via our state-of-the-art robotics technology, known as the Ocado Smart Platform ("OSP"). This proprietary hardware and software powers all online grocery operations - from our sophisticated webshop and highly automated Customer Fulfilment Centres, to our cutting edge last-mile operations.

About the role

We are looking for strong analytical problem solvers to join our Simulation Research team, where you will use simulation to understand the behaviour of our automation systems through modelling, experimentation and data analysis. You will work closely with stakeholders to offer them practical insight from simulation, and perform research to guide the design of some of our most advanced systems. Through research, experimentation and collaboration, you will become an expert in some of our most advanced and complex technology.

We’ve been building and operating cutting-edge warehouse automation for a long time, and simulation research is still a key strategic capability for Ocado Group. Whether it’s guiding our rollout of robotic arms, balancing latency against efficiency, or helping to scale down our solution to fit in the back of an existing store, there are always new business problems that benefit from simulation insight.

Projects can vary a lot, but you might find yourself working on:

• Estimating hardware requirements for a new site

• Iterating on new hardware designs

• Consulting on live system constraints and optimisations

• Building standard experiment designs and analysis tooling

About Simulation Research 

You will be part of an open and collaborative team split between the UK and Bulgaria, working closely together to provide stakeholders with trustworthy, actionable insight.

As a simulation researcher, you will regularly switch between:

• Liaising with stakeholders to clearly understand their requirements

• Designing appropriate models, experiments and analysis to produce trustworthy data from our simulation model

• Analysing large datasets in depth to build a full picture of the system performance

• Sharing results both verbally and in writing, providing clear but nuanced insight in an accessible way

• Defining metrics and building data infrastructure and tooling, in collaboration with other teams

About you

You need to be highly numerate and comfortable working with data, with a keen eye for detail and the inquisitiveness and motivation to understand things in depth. You’ll be a fast learner, able to quickly pick up new ideas and use a wide range of tools to solve challenging problems.

Having said that, we care just as much about your soft skills. Great written and verbal communication (in English) is essential, telling a clear story through data to technical and non-technical teams, which also requires building an understanding of what a stakeholder really needs and cares about. You need to care as much about getting the process right and building relationships as you do about the numbers.

The most fundamental requirement of all is that you’re always motivated to do better, whether this means improving yourself or helping your team find better ways of working.

That’s what we care about most, although we would also value any experience with relevant analysis tools or approaches (e.g. Python, SQL, statistics, data engineering), as well as professional or academic data-driven research, particularly if it involves simulation or modelling. Experience in a related domain or working with development teams and business stakeholders would also be a plus.

What we offer 

• Hybrid office attendance policy that sees you onsite 60%/40% of your time (this depends on the position and whether it's within SCC or tech)

• 30 days of “Work from anywhere” program

• 25 days of annual leave

• 100 EUR monthly for food vouchers

• 50 EUR social allowance paid with your monthly

title: Senior Security Research Engineer, SONAR (Security Operations and Novel Adversary Research)
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

SONAR is the adversary research team within Elastic Security. We discover novel adversary behavior through malware reverse engineering, threat hunting, and vulnerability research, turn every discovery into protections that ship to customers, and share our work publicly through Elastic Security Labs. We want to make environments hostile to adversaries, and to put rare knowledge and tooling within reach of every defender. We are looking for a Senior Security Research Engineer to take on our hardest analysis work and help set the technical direction of the team. Our geographically dispersed team values positivity and inclusivity in the workplace, clear communication, collaborative learning, and guided mentorship.

Our research is public, and much of it is work you may already know: this team identified the supply chain compromise of the axios npm package, uncovered a new Contagious Interview campaign hiding DPRK malware inside SVG images, and published in-depth analyses of the TCLBANKER banking trojan and the PHANTOMPULSE RAT, each one paired with protections that shipped to customers. If you have a passion for taking apart what adversaries build, and would enjoy the challenge of getting that understanding into customers' hands quickly, join our growing team!

What You Will Be Doing

• Reverse engineer malware nobody has documented yet. Take apart obfuscated and packed samples across Windows, macOS, and Linux, and recover how they communicate, configure themselves, and stay hidden.

• Operate global data systems to identify and mitigate threats. Work through data from millions of endpoints to surface the activity worth investigating, build the campaign context that tells customers who is targeting them, and push mitigation back out across the fleet.

• Turn every discovery into a shipped protection, and the tooling that scales it. Author the signatures that stop what you find, and build the automation and AI-assisted workflows that make the next investigation faster than the last.

• Build your public research reputation. Publish on Elastic Security Labs, release tools and detection artifacts to our public GitHub repositories, and present at conferences. We encourage a public persona and the relationships in the research community that come with it.

• Collaborate across Elastic Security. Your discoveries become the rules and models that neighboring teams build and ship, and you will work with those teams directly on shared threat intelligence and detection engineering projects.

• Help lead the team's technical direction. Take point on investigations that run for months, raise the bar in review, and mentor researchers earlier in their careers.

What You Bring

• 6+ years of professional experience reverse engineering malware and researching adversary tradecraft, static and dynamic, across multiple executable formats (PE, ELF, Mach-O) and architectures (x86-64, ARM), including obfuscated and packed code that defeats automated tooling.

• Python development experience for research tooling and automation, plus the ability to read C and C++. Malware arrives in Rust, Go, and NodeJS too, so you are willing to learn a new runtime when a sample demands it.

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

We're hiring a Senior Product Builder to focus on the Creator experience at ShopMy. Creators use ShopMy to discover brands, build storefronts, earn commissions, and grow audiences through our tools. Your job is to make every part of that experience so good that creators can't imagine working without ShopMy. You'll own key surfaces of the creator-facing product, such as: onboarding, storefronts, affiliate tools, earnings, discovery, and the daily workflows that keep creators engaged and earning.

This is not a role where you write requirements and hand them off. You will take unclear signals - from creator feedback, data, internal teams, and the market - and turn them into concrete product ideas. Then you will see those ideas through until they are live in production and changing real behavior.

You are a full-stack builder. Your skills don't stop where someone else's begin. You think in complete systems. When you do this well, execution accelerates because translation is no longer required.

You are a creative. You understand that great product doesn't emerge in a straight line. You're comfortable sitting in ambiguity long enough to find something genuinely good, but not so long that nothing ships. You know when to open up possibilities and when to collapse them into something real. You create space when it's needed and apply pressure when it's time to get a project over the line.

You are a sleuth. The organization will hand you noise - feature requests, complaints, partial diagnoses. You assume what you're hearing is filtered, incomplete, or slightly wrong. You read between the lines, apply trained product judgment, and uncover the real problem worth solving. You don't take things at face value. You do the work to find the truth underneath.

• Ship real product into production and stay close through the final mile - you care how the feature actually behaves, where it breaks, how it performs

• Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, UXR, and Data to move from signal to shipped product at high velocity

title: AI Architect
description:
Job Title: AI Architect
Location : Remote (anywhere from India)
Timings :11 am to 8pm

Job Summary
This is a foundational hire. AI is being built and shipped across every product line in the portfolio, often in isolation. Duplication of models, tools, and infrastructure is driving up cost and slowing us down. The AI Architect will lead the definition of our target-state AI architecture, stand up the central AI services platform that every product will consume, and drive the delivery roadmap that consolidates and scales AI across the portfolio.
The role is technical and strategic. You will make the architecture decisions, then own their execution. You will build a small central team over time, but in the first six months you will operate primarily as a hands-on architect and delivery lead. AI is Phase 1 of a broader central services strategy at PairSoft ; the pattern you set here will extend to other shared capabilities.

Responsibilities / Essential Functions
Architecture

• Define and publish the target-state AI architecture across the product lines, including central services versus application-layer boundaries.

• Own the technology decisions: foundation model providers, orchestration frameworks, vector stores, evaluation and observability platforms, guardrails, and agent frameworks.

• Establish architecture decision criteria and the decision-record process. Ensure every significant call is defensible, documented, and revisitable.

• Design for tenant isolation, PII handling, and regional data residency from day one, working with the CISO on the security envelope.

Delivery

• Lead the build of the central AI platform: model gateway, prompt registry, RAG-as-a-service, guardrails and content safety, evals and telemetry, cost attribution, and audit logging.

• Own the phased roadmap: discovery and decisions, platform build, migration of existing product AI features to the platform, and optimization.

• Partner with product engineering leaders across all product lines to migrate existing AI features onto the central platform without disrupting customer commitments.

• Set the operational bar: observability, SLOs, incident response, and on-call model for AI services.

Governance & Economics

• Stand up per-request cost tagging and the AI unit economics dashboard. Track cost per feature, per customer, and per model. Enforce budgets and rate limits per tenant.

• Chair a cross-product AI Council to govern shared standards, new use case intake, and vendor decisions.

• Own vendor relationships for AI infrastructure and tooling. Lead build-versus-buy analysis and commercial negotiation with product and finance partners.

• Prepare and represent the AI architecture and roadmap in leadership reviews and private-equity sponsor conversations, including technical due diligence.

Team

• Recruit and lead the AI Platform team as the function grows.

• Establish the operating model between the central platform team and embedded AI engineers across product lines.

• Mentor engineers across the portfolio on AI patterns, evaluation practices, and safe deployment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

• 10+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior architecture roles at enterprise B2B SaaS companies.

• 3+ years of hands-on production experience with LLM-based systems: RAG, agents, evaluation, prompt engineering, and inference optimization.

• 3+ years people management experience, including recruitment, motivation and development of 3+ teams in global setting.

• Demonstrated track record building an AI or ML platform consumed by multiple product teams. You have designed and shipped shared infrastructure, not just individual features.

• Strong delivery leadership. You have shipped platforms on time, on budget, and with the operational discipline required to run them in production.

• Deep cloud-native architecture experience on Azure and AWS. Comfort with Kube

title: Director of Pricing
description:
About Landing

We are a nationwide hospitality platform where fully-furnished apartments meet hotel quality and consistency. Guests access a curated selection of thousands of high-quality apartments available for any length of stay in hundreds of cities nationwide.
By blending the best of hospitality and everyday comfort, every unit is designed with all the amenities of home backed by 24/7 local support. For a week-long getaway or an extended adventure, We deliver a familiar and frictionless guest experience that’s perfect for any travel occasion, for work or pleasure.
For property owners, We offer a fast path to new revenue and higher occupancy in just weeks by tapping into our nationwide demand for furnished, hospitality-grade housing. We provide a turnkey solution that covers the entire unit experience, from furnishings to guest turnover and everything in between, with zero operational lift from partners. We handle it all so partners can unlock value faster.
The Role
We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic pricing leader to own revenue optimization across our rapidly growing portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of data science, strategy, and execution, responsible for driving measurable impact on occupancy, revenue, and profitability.
You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations to shape pricing decisions at the home, market, and network level.
Key Responsibilities

• Own pricing and revenue optimization strategy for all homes, balancing occupancy, rate, and contribution profit.

• Enhance and scale our machine learning-driven pricing model.

• Develop and deploy dynamic pricing logic for lifecycle stages (launch vs. mature), stay lengths, and distribution channels.

• Build and maintain pricing and performance dashboards using Python, SQL, and Looker.

• Run elasticity tests, scenario modeling, and pacing analysis to guide decisions with a test-and-learn mindset.

• Integrate external data sources (AirDNA, CoStar) into pricing strategies.

• Partner with Marketing on channel mix and ROAS tradeoffs, ensuring OTA vs. direct pricing alignment.

• Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership to influence revenue and investment decisions.

What You’ll Bring

• 7-10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, or data analytics (ideally in hospitality, travel, or other perishable-inventory industries).

• Hands-on fluency with revenue management systems and multi-property pricing strategies.

• Experience building or managing algorithmic or ML-based pricing systems.

• Deep understanding of price elasticity, occupancy forecasting, and RevPAR optimization.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complex analyses for executives.

• High bias for action and comfort operating in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience with OTA pricing or channel management (Airbnb, Expedia, Booking.com).

• Familiarity with CoStar or AirDNA datasets.

• Strong Python skills (pandas, statsmodels, etc.) for building revenue analytics and modeling.

• Ability to design and interpret statistical tests to balance revenue and conversion outcomes.

• Experience in high-growth startups or tech-enabled real estate.

What we offer

• Competitive compensation + stock options

• Comprehensive benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Disability, Mental Health, Pet, Commuter, FSA or HSA

• 401(k) plan and access to ImmediatePay

• Generous PTO policy

• Opportunities for upward mobility - we want you to grow with us

• $750 annually in Landing Stays
